comment: Receipts recorded on Arc mainnet by the reference service. Listed by transaction hash rather than discovered by scanning: the public RPC rejects eth_getLogs over more than ~5,000 blocks, and at 0.5s per block the gap from the registry's deployment grows by ~172,800 blocks a day. Maintained by hand: add an entry after a run worth showing.
apiComment: Base URL of the live service. null hides the interactive demo. Append ?api=http://localhost:3000 to the page URL to drive it against a local service. Free hosting sleeps when idle, so the first request after a quiet spell takes about a minute.

receipts.note: Paid, and checkable end to end: the input is the globe in this repo, the output is published beside the transcript, and the receipt is bound to the payment's own nonce.
The sample globe in this repo: 1.97 MB in, 0.27 MB out. 9,216 triangles and 4,753 vertices both ways.
The first paid call, $0.02 in USDC. The file it covers was an earlier fixture that is no longer in the repo, so only its sizes can be checked now — and it predates payment binding.
